_comment: RETOLD memory-film template for Shotstack. integrations/shotstack.py loads this, then fills timeline.tracks with per-chapter Ken-Burns illustration clips, real-voice audio clips, and word-for-word captions built from book.json. A non-technical owner can safely tweak look-and-feel here (background colour, output resolution, fonts in the caption HTML) without touching Python. HONESTY: the only audio ever placed on the timeline is the parent's REAL trimmed voice clip files plus an optional soft licensed music bed — voices are never cloned or synthesized.

soundtrack._comment: Optional. shotstack.py overrides src with env MUSIC_URL (licensed bed) at low volume, far under the real voice. Remove if you want voice only.

tracks._comment: Track 0 (captions) — filled at build time with the parent's own words, one per chapter.
Track 1 (brand) — filled at build time with the opening RETOLD title card and any lower-thirds.
Track 2 (imagery) — filled at build time with Ken-Burns pans across the book's painterly illustrations (never photoreal faces).
Track 3 (voice) — filled at build time with the REAL trimmed voice clips, sequential and gapless.

output._comment: hd = 720p, matching the economy default (720p for feed). Bump to '1080' for a premium keepsake export.
